title: Immunostaining Protocol for Gastruloids
author: Stefano D Vianello
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7tzhnp6
materials: Cover with aluminium foil and wait 00:10:00 min

steps.title: Harvest Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Collect Gastruloids from the inner 60 wells of a 96-well plate, avoiding the 36 border wells to ensure reproducibility.

substeps.instruction: Use a cut P1000 tip to aspirate Gastruloids by placing the tip straight down to the bottom of each well.
Deposit collected Gastruloids into a 15mL centrifuge tube.
Allow Gastruloids to sediment to the bottom of the tube and remove as much medium as possible using a vacuum pump and glass pipette.
Gently resuspend Gastruloids in ~5mL PBS-/- to dilute remaining medium traces.

steps.title: Fix Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Fix the Gastruloids using 4% PFA in a 6-well plate under a fume hood with appropriate PPE.

substeps.instruction: Remove serum-containing medium (e.g., PBSFT) from a 6-well plate and replace with 2mL 4% PFA.
Coat a cut P1000 tip in PBS+FT to prevent sticking.

Transfer Gastruloids from the tube to the PFA by touching the surface vertically to minimize liquid transfer (for 48h Gastruloids, push the whole tip contents into the wash without waiting for them to sink).
Cover the plate with aluminium foil to reduce fluorescence loss.
Incubate at 4 °C for 02:00:00, with or without an orbital shaker.

steps.title: Wash Fixed Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Remove PFA by washing the Gastruloids with PBS-/-.

substeps.instruction: Fill wells of a 6-well plate with 4mL PBS-/-.
Transfer fixed Gastruloids into the PBS-/-.
Repeat for two more washes (total of 3).

Note: Gastruloids can be transferred serially across three PBS-filled wells and left for 10 minutes only in the last one. They can be stored in the last PBS wash at 4 °C, protected from light, for months.

steps.title: Block Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Block the Gastruloids at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Transfer Gastruloids to a well filled with 2mL PBS+FT.
Block for 01:00:00 h at room temperature, with or without a shaker.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate Gastruloids with primary antibodies and DAPI.

substeps.instruction: For each antibody combination and sample condition, prepare a 1.5mL Eppendorf tube with 500uL of appropriate antibodies in PBSFT, including DAPI 1:500.
Transfer each antibody solution into a separate well of a 48-well plate.
Transfer an equal number of Gastruloids to each well.
Cover with aluminium foil and incubate for 24:00:00 at 4 °C on an orbital shaker.
Transfer Gastruloids to a well of a 6-well plate filled with 3mL PBS+FT (use a separate well for each sample condition).
Repeat for two more washes (total of 3, total time 01:00:00 h).
Note: Gastruloids can be transferred serially across three PBSFT-filled wells and left for 20 minutes only in the last one.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate Gastruloids with secondary antibodies and DAPI.

substeps.instruction: For each antibody combination and sample condition, prepare 500uL of appropriate secondary antibodies in PBSFT, including DAPI 1:500.
Transfer each antibody solution into a separate well of a 48-well plate.
Transfer each Gastruloid set to its appropriate secondary solution.
Cover with aluminium foil and incubate for 24:00:00 at 4 °C on an orbital shaker.
Transfer Gastruloids to a well of a 6-well plate filled with 3mL PBS+FT (use a separate well for each sample condition).
Repeat for two more washes (total of 3, total time 01:00:00 h).
Note: Gastruloids can be transferred serially across three PBSFT-filled wells and left for 20 minutes only in the last one.

steps.title: Mount Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Mount the Gastruloids on microscope slides for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Add a drop of ~30uL Fluoromount-G to the center of a microscope slide (optionally use a spacer made of double-sided sticky tape for samples 168h or later).
Transfer Gastruloids to the drop; use an eyelash tool to separate any clusters.
Place a small drop of mounting medium at the center of a coverslip, then gently drop the coverslip on top of the samples.
Absorb excess liquid from the edges using a Kimtech wipe.
Seal all sides of the coverslip with Permount hardening resin or nail polish.
Store slides in a box away from light at 4 °C until imaging.
